overview.description: Monitor training order program status, pool, rounds, and applicants.

templates.title: Training request templates
templates.description: Reusable templates for training pool requests. Each template can generate bidding or fixed-price training orders.
templates.deleteConfirm: Do you want to delete this template?

templateWizard.filesSkipHelp: Attachments are not stored with templates yet; you can skip this step.
templateWizard.reviewNote: This template will be saved only — no marketplace order is created.
templateWizard.projectTypeHelpFixed: Fixed price: a single budget and duration used as the training order model.
templateWizard.projectTypeHelpBidding: Bidding: a budget range and duration range used when generating training orders.
templateWizard.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe the order clearly and in detail
templateWizard.budgetFixedHelp: Enter a whole-number budget within an approved span (e.g. 20–1000 JOD).
templateWizard.budgetBiddingHelp: Enter an approved budget range (e.g. 50–100 or 100–150 JOD). Close values are adjusted automatically.
templateWizard.filesInfoBody: Attachments are not saved with templates yet. Continue to review to save the template.

rounds.title: Round history
rounds.description: Only one active training round at a time. Starting a new round ends the previous one and removes its requests from the marketplace immediately, while history remains here for review.

applications.title: Training request applicants
applications.description: Applicants on training pool requests, grouped by training order.
applications.monitoringNote: This page is for monitoring only and does not affect real orders.

settings.title: Training request settings
settings.description: Enable the marketplace, automate rounds, distribute across categories, and visibility options.
settings.visibilityOnHelp: Freelancers see orders matching the visibility and plan settings below. Turning this off hides training orders from the marketplace without deleting templates or rounds.
settings.visibilityOffHelp: Training orders are hidden from the marketplace and freelancers. Templates, rounds, and applications remain saved.
settings.visibilityShownSuccess: Training orders are now shown in the marketplace.
settings.visibilityHiddenSuccess: Training orders are now hidden from the marketplace.
settings.ordersPerRoundHelp: The system randomly selects a number between the minimum and maximum when creating each round.
settings.categoryDistributionHelp: These percentages affect which types of orders appear in new rounds. Total must equal 100%.
settings.visibilityHelp: When enabled, training orders can appear to freelancers based on round and category settings.
settings.advancedHint: To show visitors, link plans, or name a round, open Advanced settings below.
settings.visibilityRequired: Enable visibility for freelancers, visitors, or select a plan — see Advanced settings.
settings.orderRangeSaveError: Minimum orders cannot exceed maximum orders.
settings.distributionSaveError: Content / programming / design percentages must total 100%.
settings.visibilitySaveError: Enable freelancer or visitor visibility, or select at least one plan (Advanced settings).
